explanation.text:
WILH. WILHELMSEN HOLDING ASA (org.nr 995 277 905) is registered as Allmennaksjeselskap (ASA), founded 2010-02-25, registered 2010-03-11. Business address: Strandveien 20, 1366 LYSAKER. Main industry (NACE): 52.220 Andre tjenester tilknyttet sjøtransport. Registered employees: 29 (as of 2026-09-10). Latest filed annual accounts (2025, company statement): revenue NOK 25,179,000; operating result NOK -165,393,000; net result NOK 4,291,632,000; total assets NOK 14,179,175,000; equity NOK 12,576,014,000 (the group statement for the same year reports revenue USD 1,231,000,000). Leadership: general manager (daglig leder) Thomas Wilhelmsen; board chair Carl Erik Steen; 4 other board members. Sub-units registered: 1. Website: www.wilhelmsen.com. The website describes the company as: "Our vision is to shape the maritime industry. Through innovation, expertise, quality products and services we are able to meet the challenges and needs of the world's global fleet." LEI: 54930050TPKOLSE1ZZ71 (ACTIVE). Wikipedia: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wilh._Wilhelmsen.
